camel_example: aliyun bssopenapi ConvertChargeType --region cn-hangzhou --SubscriptionType Subscription --ProductCode rds --InstanceId 'rm-kasjgfjshgf' --ProductType rds --Period 6
description_en: Changes the billing method for an instance. You can convert Server Load Balancer (SLB), elastic IP addresses (EIPs), and NAT Gateway instances from pay-as-you-go to subscription. You can also convert SLB and EIP instances from subscription to pay-as-you-go
description_zh: 为一个实例变更订阅类型。目前支持SLB、EIP和NAT网关后付费实例转预付费实例，和SLB、EIP产品预付费转后付费实例操作
kebab_example: aliyun bssopenapi convert-charge-type --product-type rds --subscription-type Subscription --period 6 --product-code rds --instance-id rm-kasjgfjshgf --api-version 2017-12-14 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ConvertChargeType

parameters.description_en:
The current billing method of the instance. Valid values:

- Subscription: The instance is a subscription instance.

- PayAsYouGo: The instance is a pay-as-you-go instance.

> After a successful call, the billing method of the instance is switched.
parameters.description_zh:
实例当前的付费类型，取值：
- Subscription：预付费。
- PayAsYouGo：后付费。

> 调用成功后资源将被更变为相反的类型。

parameters.description_en:
The subscription duration, in months. This parameter is required if you change the billing method to subscription. Valid values:

- 1 to 9.

- 12\.

- 24\.

- 36\.
